name: whats-next
description: Your issues and what's next, from Forgejo, GitLab or GitHub, in a docked pane

token.title: Forgejo tokens
token.description: Forgejo or Gitea access tokens, kept in secure storage. A bare token is for every host; more hosts take host=token pairs separated by spaces. A pair wins over a bare token. Needs write:issue, read:repository and read:user to assign and close; read:issue instead of write:issue is read only.

gitlabComToken.title: GitLab.com token
gitlabComToken.description: A gitlab.com access token, kept in secure storage. api lets What's Next assign and close; read_api is read only.

gitlabTokens.title: Private GitLab token
gitlabTokens.description: An access token for your own GitLab, any host but gitlab.com, kept in secure storage. api lets What's Next assign and close; read_api is read only. host=token pairs separated by spaces still work for more than one host.

githubTokens.title: GitHub token
githubTokens.description: A GitHub access token, for github.com and GitHub Enterprise, kept in secure storage. Fine-grained: Issues read and write to assign and close, read for read only; classic: repo. host=token pairs separated by spaces for more than one host; a pair wins over a bare token.

label.title: Epic label
label.description: The label that makes an issue an epic. Its children are the issues it depends on; on GitLab, the issues it links as related; on GitHub, its sub-issues.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Count What's Next's requests to the forge, on a line under the repo line: the last action's and the session's.

compact.title: Compact
compact.description: Lists without an empty line between rows. ask: What's Next asks once, after setup.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Buttons as Nerd Font icons, which needs a Nerd Font in the terminal, or as words. ask: What's Next asks once, after setup.
